messages:
oliver: FYI i've consolidated the past 7 warmup regressions into a single recurrence analysis. found 4 repeat signatures and a proposed set of mitigations + tracking fields. want quick ack and owners.

danielle: paste the signatures and one log snip pls.

oliver: signatures i found:
- udev/modprobe timing out during gpu module init -> warmup abort
- firmware/driver mismatch causing NVRM Xid errors -> node reboot loop
- autoscaler preemption: pod evicted while shard download still in progress
- network blips during cold start causing shard fetch timeouts

example log:
```
[2026-03-29T07:11:02Z] warmup: starting shard download 0/16
[2026-03-29T07:11:05Z] system: modprobe nvidia_uvm returned exit 127
[2026-03-29T07:11:06Z] warmup: aborting due to module init failure
```

rui: interesting — the network blips cluster looks separate from vendor rollouts. did we see any cloud-network maintenance windows on those dates?

beatrix: vendor rolled firmware in eu pools 2026-03-10 and us pools 2026-03-18. the firmware/driver mismatch correlates strongly with the reboot loop signatures.

ops-bot: [ALERT] 1965432801 warmup_recurrence_alert for pool:redwood-dedicated-usw-03 (4 failures in 36h)

oliver: Proposed immediate (24-48h) mitigations:
- danielle -> targeted rollback for nodes with kernel oops (owner: danielle) due 2026-04-01 EOD
- rui -> implement single retry + 5s backoff for modprobe/udev step behind FF (owner: rui) due 2026-04-01 noon
- beatrix -> temporary routing steering away from pools with >2 incidents in 24h (owner: beatrix) due 2026-04-01 EOD
- oliver -> enable conservative shard-fetch timeout increase for 48h on affected pools (owner: oliver) due 2026-04-01 EOD

longer-term (2-6 weeks):
- infra -> enforce AMI/firmware pinning + rollout gating for Dedicated fleets (owner: danielle + infra) due 2026-04-20
- runtime -> autoscaler lease so warmup pods are immune to eviction (owner: rui) due 2026-04-08
- obs -> create "warmup-recurrence" dashboard with recurrence_count, fallback_rate, warmup_abort_count (owner: beatrix) due 2026-04-05
- process -> add recurrence_count + hypothesis_tag + mitigation_owner fields to postmortem template (owner: ops) due 2026-04-07

danielle: creating TKT-7233 now and will attach historical incident list and verification steps.

beatrix: for the dashboard primary KPI = fallback_rate (customer-facing) and breakdown by signature as a secondary panel. i'll add recurrence_count table with linked tickets.

rui: will keep modprobe retry behind FF and instrument retry_count metric. will run canary for 48h.

oliver: propose we add a "recurrence_hypothesis" tag to each action so future postmortems can filter which hypothesis each mitigation addresses. reduces duplicated fixes.

ops-bot: [INFO] TKT-7233 created and assigned to danielle; priority: P1

danielle: rollback scheduled 2026-03-31 04:00 UTC. ETA 90m. will post verification here.

[~2h later]

danielle: rollback complete on targeted nodes in usw-03. warmup success improved from 74% -> 95% on those nodes over 60min. attached smoke test logs to TKT-7233.

beatrix: dashboard draft available at https://go/internal/dashboards/warmup-recurrence-7233 (internal) — feedback welcome. added recurrence_count and signature breakdown.

rui: canary with modprobe retry shows 40% fewer transient init failures so far. holding for 24h.

oliver: next steps: owners to update TKT-7233 with runbooks, add recurrence metadata, and set expected close dates. we'll reconvene in 2 weeks to check recurrence and decide whether to escalate to a reliability epic. thanks everyone. :pray:

beatrix: scheduling a 20m follow-up in #incidents for 2026-04-12 to review recurrence metrics.

oliver: thread paused; reopen if regression observed.
